card.name: The digit 2 inside numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 2 as a single-digit piece inside longer numbers, such as DOI codes, years after 20, URLs and phone numbers.

modes.label: DOI and URL codes
modes.description: The digit 2 right after a DOI prefix or inside a long URL number.

modes.label: Years starting 20
modes.description: The 2 following 20 in a year, as in a revision date or a health target.

modes.label: Phone and dose numbers
modes.description: The 2 inside a poison-line number or a strength figure.

card.plain: It marks the digit 2 when it sits inside a longer number like a year, DOI or phone number.
